hints.en: Tell her you speak a little Cantonese.
t: ngo5 sik1 gong2 siu2 siu2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.

hints.en: Thank her for holding the door.
Say OK, bye, as you get out of the lift.
Say excuse me and ask if she can say it one more time.
t: 唔好意思，可唔可以講多次呀？
m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 do1 ci3 aa3?

hints.en: Ask her to speak a bit slower, please.
Say the number back, one hundred and eight, and check that it's right.
t: jat1 baak3 ling4 baat3, hai6 m4 hai6 aa3?

hints.en: Thank her a lot for her help.
